home.title: Babban Injiniya Cikakkun Tari | Samfura & Tsarin
home.footer: An fassara gidan yanar gizon yanzu kuma ana samunsa cikin harsuna 100+!
home.descriptionA: Babban injiniya mai cikakken tari tare da shekaru 6+ na gwaninta yana ɗaukar samfura daga buƙatun shubuha zuwa amintattun tsarin samarwa. Na tsara gine-ginen da ke bayan React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, da aikace-aikacen SQL: bayyanannun iyakokin sabis, samfuran bayanai masu dorewa, amintattun hanyoyin samun dama, da ƙungiyoyin hanyoyin isar da sako na iya aiki tare da amincewa.
home.descriptionB: Aikina yana haɗa shawarar injiniya zuwa sakamakon kasuwanci. Daga SaaS mai ƙididdige gine-gine wanda ke juya bayanan maƙunsar bayanai zuwa shawarwarin shirye-shiryen abokin ciniki zuwa dandamalin yanar gizo masu samar da kudaden shiga, Ina gina software a kusa da ayyukan aiki, haɗari, da auna ma'auni mai mahimmanci ga mutanen da ke amfani da shi.

takeoff_engine.summary: Takardun rubutu marasa daidaituwa a ciki. Ƙididdigar gini da shawarwari masu shirye don abokin ciniki a waje. Samfurin SaaS da aka gina kewaye da ainihin tsarin aiki na ɗan kwangila.
takeoff_engine.lens: Shigowa masu sassauƙa suna buƙatar samfurin ciki mai ƙarfi: karɓar ƙarin fomats bai kamata ya raunana ƙa'idodin lissafin da wani tayi ya dogara kan ba.

inventory_register.summary: Tsarin aiki na wurin siyarwa tare da Angular da Node.js wanda ya haɗa masu amfani da aka tantance, daidaiton kaya, da kuma tsarin biyan kuɗi na kwaikwayo.
inventory_register.lens: Rejista fiye da allon biyan kuɗi ce. Matsayi, canje-canjen kaya, da yanayin biyan kuɗi na buƙatar iyakoki a bayyane don tsarin aiki ya kasance mai alhaki.

grocery_app.summary: Aikace-aikacen .NET 9 Blazor tare da iyakokin mai sarrafawa, sabis, da ma'ajiya, dorewar Entity Framework Core, da cikakken saitin gwaji.
grocery_app.lens: Rarrabuwa tana samun wurinta lokacin da za a iya gwada ƙa'idodin kasuwanci ba tare da la'akari da mu'amala da Layer na dorewa ba.

payrollobol.summary: Aikin albashi na GnuCOBOL ya haɗu da babban littafin shigarwa biyu na SQLite da kuma dashboard na aiki na Svelte.
payrollobol.lens: Daidaiton kuɗi yana farawa da wakilci: lissafin cikakken santi da rikodin masu daidaitawa suna bayyana motsin kuɗi.

interop.summary: Bayani tsakanin harsuna wanda ya ƙunshi harsuna {languages} na shirye-shirye da tsarin aiwatarwa {patterns}, yana bincika abin da ke faruwa a iyakokin lokacin aiki.
interop.lens: Bangaren da ke da wahala shine kwangilar da ke tsakanin lokutan aiki: musayar bayanai, halayen tsari, da aiwatarwa mai maimaituwa sun fi muhimmanci fiye da syntax.

formatter.summary: Injin bincike na Go na gaske wanda aka haɗa zuwa WebAssembly. Tabbatarwa da tsara JSON da YAML na aiki a cikin burauza.
formatter.lens: Ƙaura mai bincike zuwa burauza yana musayar babban nauyin abokin ciniki don sarrafa na gida, tsari, da ƙarancin dogaro da uwar garken.

portfolio_website.summary: Shafin da kake ciki: portfolio na React mai harsuna 100+, mu'amala mai dama, da kayan aikin WebAssembly masu aiki.
portfolio_website.lens: Aiwatarwa na tsaye ba ya nufin ƙwarewar tsaye ba. Ƙwararriyar mu'amala na iya rayuwa a ɓangaren abokin ciniki ba tare da uwar garken aikace-aikace ba.

biblioteca.summary: Bututun yarewa na Python wanda ke canza tushen abun ciki guda ɗaya zuwa portfolio da aka samu cikin harsuna 100+.
biblioteca.lens: Isar da duniya matsala ce ta kiyaye bayanai kamar yadda take da fassara. Tushen gaskiya ɗaya yana sa canje-canjen abun ciki a sarrafa.

personal_summary.title: Takaitaccen Bayani
personal_summary.text: Ni babban injiniya ne mai cikakken tari wanda ke zaune a Orlando, FL wanda ya mallaki hanya daga matsalar samfur zuwa sakamakon samarwa. Ina yin zaɓin fasaha a cikin sabis na tsarin: NET da Tsarin Tsarin Haɓakawa lokacin da ƙaƙƙarfan tsarin yanki da abin dagewa za'a iya gwadawa; Angular ko Amsa lokacin da hadaddun ayyukan aiki suna buƙatar dubawa mai kulawa; Node.js ko Go lokacin da API, haɗin kai, ko babban aiki kayan aiki yana buƙatar lokacin aiki mai mahimmanci. A duk faɗin samfuran SaaS, ayyukan aiki na ciki, da dandamali masu fuskantar abokin ciniki, Ina jagora tare da fayyace fage, ƙira mai aminci da juriya, gwajin sarrafa kansa, da ayyukan isarwa waɗanda Taimakawa ƙungiyoyi don jigilar software mai mahimmanci ba tare da barin bashin aiki a baya ba.

entries.title: Injiniya Cikakkun Tari
entries.text: Ina jagorantar isar da samfur na ƙarshe-zuwa-ƙarshen: fassara ayyukan kasuwanci zuwa iyakokin tsarin, ƙirar bayanai, APIs, da musaya, sannan ɗaukar aikin ta hanyar gwaji, turawa, da maimaitawa. Manufar ita ce software da ƙungiya za ta iya haɓakawa da aiki, ba tarin hotunan allo ba.

entries.title: Samfura & Tsarin Gine-gine
entries.text: Na zaɓi dandamali da alamu dangane da matsalar: sabis na .NET mai layi don wuraren kasuwanci, aikace-aikacen Angular ko React mai sarrafa kayan aiki don hadaddun ayyuka, alaƙa samfuran bayanai don ayyukan aiki masu lissafin lissafi, da haɗin kai da aka tsara tare da yanayin gazawa, ikon samun dama, da kiyayewa a hankali.

entries.title: Bayarwa-Shirya Bayarwa
entries.text: Ina ginawa tare da gaskiyar bayan ƙaddamar da ra'ayi: sirrin da aka kiyaye su daga sarrafa tushe, ƙayyadaddun hanyoyin ƙaura na bayanai, izini na tushen rawar, inganci a iyakokin tsarin, gwaje-gwaje na atomatik, wayar da kan jama'a ta CI/CD, da kuma lura da aiki. Waɗannan su ne cikakkun bayanai waɗanda ke juya samfuri zuwa software mai dogaro.

biblioteca.title: Biblioteca JSON
biblioteca.text: Bututun da ke tushen Python wanda ke juya tushen tushen abun ciki guda ɗaya zuwa babban fayil mai isa ga duniya. Yana sarrafa bayanan fassarar azaman tsarin da za'a iya kiyayewa maimakon kwafin shafi da hannu, ba da damar rukunin yanar gizon ya yi ƙima a cikin harsuna sama da 100 kuma yana sa duniya ta kai matsayin kofi. iya aiki maimakon fasalin lokaci ɗaya.

connect_four.title: Haɗa Huɗu
connect_four.text: Ɗangila mai girma na {implementations} aiwatarwa na wasan Hudu a Jere. Aikin ya ƙunshi harsuna {languages} na shirye-shirye, gami da Java, C++, Python, da JavaScript, tare da frameworks, littattafai, lokutan aiki, da bayanai {frameworks} daban-daban, daga React, Angular, da Blazor zuwa Django, Spring Boot, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, da ƙari.

grocery_app.title: App na Kayan Abinci
grocery_app.text: Cikakken kayan aikin NET 9 Blazor Server wanda ke nuna tsarin gine-ginen baya na niyya don tafiyar da kasuwanci. Rarraba mai sarrafawa/sabis/maajiyar tana kiyaye dokokin aikace-aikace, samun damar bayanai, da gabatarwa daban-daban; Tsarin Tsarin Halittu Core yana ba da dorewa mai dorewa; da kuma babban ɗakin gwaji yana kare ɗabi'a yayin da samfurin ke tasowa.

interop.title: Interop Project
interop.text: Ma'anar ma'amala tsakanin harshen giciye wanda ya ƙunshi harsunan shirye-shirye {languages} da tsarin aiwatarwa {patterns}. Aikin yana bincika iyakar inda tsarin yakan zama mai rauni: kwangilar tsari, musayar bayanai, halayen lokacin aiki, da hanyoyin haɗin kai mai maimaitawa. Yana nuna tunanin tsarin da ake buƙata lokacin da samfur ya fi girma fiye da tari ɗaya.

inventory_register.title: Rijistar kayayyaki
inventory_register.text: Cikakken POS mai cike da kayan aiki da kayan aiki da aka gina tare da Angular 17+ da Node.js. Yana misalta abubuwan da ke damun tsarin aiki na tsarin B2B: ingantattun masu amfani, sarrafa tushen rawar aiki, daidaiton ƙira, da kwararar biyan kuɗi na izgili. An tsara aikin a kusa da ainihin aikin da ƙungiyar rajista ke yi, ba kawai kasida na fasalulluka ba.

payrollobol.title: PayrollOBOL
payrollobol.text: Tsarin sarrafa albashi na gida wanda aka gina tare da GnuCOBOL, babban littafin shigarwa biyu na SQLite, da dashboard na aiki na Svelte. Yana amfani da lissafin cikakken santi, sarrafa albashi na batch, da dashboard loopback don sa tsarin kuɗi ya kasance a bayyane, gwadabbe, da alhaki na aiki.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Auto Formater
formatter.text: JSON na tushen burauza da ingantaccen kayan aikin YAML da aka gina a cikin Go kuma an haɗa su zuwa WebAssembly. Matsar da injin fasinja zuwa WASM yana sa hulɗar ta kasance mai amsawa kuma ta gida ga mai binciken yayin da ake amfani da fasinja na gaske don kama shigar da ba daidai ba. Misali ne da aka mayar da hankali na zabar tsarin gine-ginen lokacin aiki don aiki, ɗaukakawa, da amanar mai amfani.

takeoff_engine.title: Injin Takeoff
takeoff_engine.text: Gine-gine mai ƙididdigewa SaaS da aka gina a kusa da farashi mai tsada, aikin ɗan kwangila mai kuskuren kuskure. Samfurin React + Express yana shigar da bayanan CSV da Excel, taswirorin ginshiƙai marasa daidaituwa a cikin ƙirar yanki mai amfani, ƙididdige tono rami da juzu'in aikin ƙasa, waƙa da aiki da alama, kuma yana samar da shirye-shiryen abokin ciniki na PDF da shawarwarin Kalma. Wannan cikakken aikin injiniya ne na rayuwar samfur: tantance bayanai, ƙa'idodin lissafin, gogewar aikin mai aiki, da abubuwan da za'a iya samarwa waɗanda ke taimakawa kasuwanci don matsawa daga danyen bayanai zuwa tayi.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON Generator
minecraft_json_generator.text: JSON janareta mai nauyi wanda aka gina a cikin Python don albarkatun Minecraft & fakitin bayanai. Ana amfani da wannan aikin don samar da fayilolin JSON don mods na Minecraft, gami da abubuwan al'ada, tubalan, da mahalli. Yana da amfani sosai don ba kawai ƙirƙirar fakitin bayanai na al'ada ba, amma don mods kuma ta hanyar fasalin canza sunan na zamani.

educational_experience.title: Kwarewar Ilimi ta
educational_experience.text: Tare da ayyukana na sirri, na kuma sami ƙwarewa da yawa daga gogewar ilimi. Danna nan don duba bayanin martaba na LinkedIn don ƙarin bayani.

professional_experience.title: Kwarewar Ƙwararru ta
professional_experience.text: Shekaru shida da ƙari na ƙwarewar injiniyan ƙwararru a cikin ƙungiyoyin samfura, dandamalin kasuwanci, da software na fuskantar abokin ciniki. Ayyukana sun haɗa da gina matakan aikace-aikacen da za'a iya kiyayewa, haɗin gwiwa a duk fannonin bayarwa, da yanke shawarar fasaha tare da tsarin rayuwar samfur, aiki kasada, da kuma mallakar dogon lokaci a gani.

portfolio_website.title: Yanar Gizon Fayil na Patrick Goodwin
portfolio_website.text: Fayil ɗin amsa mai ra'ayin samarwa wanda ke kula da isa da isa ga duniya azaman buƙatun injiniya. Ya haɗa da bututun fassarar da za a iya kiyayewa don harsuna 100+, kayan aikin mu'amala da WebAssembly ke goyan baya, ƙirar UI mai amsawa da samun dama, da tsarin gine-ginen aiki. an tsara don girma yayin da ake jigilar sabon aiki.

lua_library.title: Patrick's Lua Script Library
lua_library.text: Laburare mai fa'ida na rubutun Lua don tunani na gaba. Ana amfani da wannan ɗakin karatu don sarrafa ayyuka a cikin rubutun Lua, wanda zai iya zuwa da amfani don ayyuka masu buƙata, saboda Lua yawanci yaren rubutu ne mai sauri fiye da Python da Ruby.

excel_scripts.title: Patrick's Microsoft Excel Rubutun Rubutun Rubutun (VBA)
excel_scripts.text: Laburare mai amfani na rubutun VBA don Microsoft Excel. Ana amfani da wannan ɗakin karatu don sarrafa ayyuka a cikin maƙunsar bayanai na Excel.

neovim_config.title: Patrick's Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: Tsari na Neovim na sirri. Ana amfani da wannan aikin don saita Neovim ga abin da nake so, gami da maɓalli na al'ada, jigogi, da plugins. Ana amfani da wannan aikin don sanya Neovim ya fi dacewa da mai amfani da inganci don amfanin kaina.

python_maps.title: Patrick's Map Generator
python_maps.text: Kayan aikin ba da rahoto na geospatial Python wanda aka gina tare da GeoPandas da Matplotlib don samar da gundumar Amurka da taswirar jihohi. Yana juya bayanan yanki zuwa kayan tarihi masu iya karantawa, yana nuna tunanin bututun bayanai: zaɓi ɗakunan ɗakunan karatu da suka dace, daidaita abubuwan da aka shigar, da samar da abubuwan da zasu iya haifar da. goyi bayan yanke shawara.

powershell_library.title: Patrick's PowerShell Script Library
powershell_library.text: Laburare mai fa'ida na rubutun PowerShell don tunani na gaba. Mai amfani tare da fasalin rubutun bayanan $, Na sami wannan yana taimakawa sosai don sarrafa ayyuka daga tashar Windows, saboda ni mai yawan amfani da Windows OS ne.

ruby_library.title: Patrick's Ruby Script Library
ruby_library.text: Laburare mai amfani na rubutun Ruby don tunani na gaba. Yana da amfani ga tunanin ci gaban Ruby akan Rails na gaba.

pdf_builder.title: PDF Skills Builder
pdf_builder.text: Tsarin aiki na tsara daftarin aiki wanda aka gina tare da Python, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML, da bayanan JSON da aka tsara. Yana raba bayanan da za a sake amfani da su daga samfuran gabatarwa don samar da keɓaɓɓen abubuwan dawo da PDF akai-akai, tsari mai amfani don rage aikin hannu da yin takaddun kasuwanci. maimaituwa.

rijndael_encryption.title: Rijndael Encryption Project
rijndael_encryption.text: Saitin kwatancen aiwatarwa {implementations} Rijndael a cikin bambance-bambancen 128-, 192-, da 256-bit. Sake aiwatar da algorithm mai hankali na tsaro a cikin harsunan horo ne mai horo a cikin takamaiman ƙayyadaddun bayanai, halayen da za a iya gwadawa, da iyakan iya ɗaukar matakin matakin harshe, duk ilhami masu amfani ga tsarin da ke sarrafa bayanai masu mahimmanci.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minecraft Mod
suprememc.text: Mod na Minecraft wanda ke ƙara kayan aiki na musamman, sulke, mobs, blocks, girma, da sauran ayyuka da yawa a wasan. An gina shi da farko tare da Java da Kotlin, yana tallafawa nau'ikan Minecraft 1.16 zuwa 26.2.

snake.title: Wasan maciji
snake.text: Injin Maciji mai kyau wanda aka gina tare da Rust da Macroquad, haɗe zuwa WebAssembly, kuma ana nuna shi ta hanyar HTML5 Canvas. Yana haɗa ticking na wasa na 0.12-seconds da motsi mai santsi, bayyanannun matakan wasa, sarrafawa mai sauri, sarrafa karo da yanayin nasara, da kuma cikakken saitin gwaji wanda ya rufe tsarin wasan na asali.

tiger_programming_language.title: Tiger Programming Language
tiger_programming_language.text: Yaren tsara shirye-shirye na al'ada da mai fassara da aka gina a cikin Go don bincika ƙirar lokacin aiki na harshe, halayen aiwatarwa, da cinikin aiki. Ƙirƙirar shi zuwa WebAssembly da haɗa shi a cikin fayil ɗin yana haifar da haƙiƙa, samfurin samfurin da ba a iya gani ba don aikin injiniya na matakin tsarin maimakon barin aikin a matsayin ma'ajiya-kawai gwaji.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Tiger Tailgating Pros Yanar Gizo
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: Gidan yanar gizon React da aka bayar don kasuwanci na Clemson, SC. Aikin yana fassara hadayar ƙaramin kasuwanci zuwa ƙayyadadden tafiyar abokin ciniki da kasancewar gidan yanar gizo mai dogaro, yin amfani da tunanin samfur don taimakawa ƙungiyar gaske ta canza sha'awa. cikin tambayoyi da kudaden shiga.

turing_machine.title: Aikin Turing Machine
turing_machine.text: Iyalin sama da {implementations} aiwatar da Injin Turing. An yi amfani da shi don nuna cikar turing don harsunan shirye-shirye daban-daban don bincike, musamman don Harshen Shirye-shiryen Tiger.

alkalab.title: Alkalab
alkalab.text: Dakin sinadarai na foda-yashi wanda aka gina a Rust kuma aka haɗa shi zuwa WebAssembly. Fentin yashi, ruwa, lava, baƙin ƙarfe, calcium carbide, ko guntun sodium kuma ka kalli yadda physics da chemistry ke faɗa: sodium yana fashewa a ruwa, calcium carbide yana fitar da acetylene, lava yana narkar da yashi ya zama gilashi, kuma ƙarfin nauyi kaɗai ke raba mai, mercury, da yashi. Injin yana gudanar da kayan 32 da ƙa'idodin amsawa 40 akan buffer cell, yana haskaka pixels kai tsaye daga ƙwaƙwalwar wasm ba tare da kwafi a kowane frame ba.

contact.title: Tuntube Ni
contact.description: Ina amsa tambayoyi daga imel da saƙonnin LinkedIn. Zan sake kira idan an bayar da lamba ta ta hanyar ci gaba ko akasin haka, kodayake na fi son in kiyaye lambar waya ta a sirri.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Linter
formatter.description: Kayan aiki mai inganci na tushen burauza wanda ke ingantawa da tsara JSON da YAML ta amfani da injin Go da aka harhada zuwa WebAssembly. Gine-ginen yana ci gaba da ɓarna kusa da mai amfani don amsa mai sauri, masu zaman kansu yayin aiwatar da ainihin ƙa'idodin syntax a iyakar bayanai. Ƙaƙƙarfan misali ne na ƙirƙira ingantaccen aiki na mai haɓakawa a kusa da daidaito, aiki, da amana.
formatter.more_info1: Don ƙarin bayani, koma zuwa README a cikin
formatter.empty_input: Da fatan za a shigar da wasu JSON ko YAML zuwa lint.
formatter.too_large: Shigarwa yayi girma sosai (matsakaicin 1MB da aka yarda).
formatter.fixed_yaml_spacing: ⚠ YAML yana da tazara/shiga mara inganci amma an daidaita shi ta atomatik kuma an tsara shi.

tiger.title: Harshen Tiger
tiger.description: Tiger yaren tsara shirye-shirye ne na al'ada da mai fassarar Go wanda aka gina don bincika gine-ginen lokacin aiki, nazarin harshe, da cinikin aiki. Ƙirƙirar mai fassara zuwa WebAssembly yana juya cewa tsarin yana aiki zuwa samfurin ma'amala, tushen burauzar: masu amfani zasu iya aiwatar da shirye-shirye kai tsaye yayin da lokacin aiki ya kasance mai ɗaukar nauyi. kuma keɓe daga aikace-aikacen mai watsa shiri.
